xsheet.note: the ladder leans against the haystack; a man walks in from the left
he reaches the ladder and takes the left rail with his right hand
right foot on the bottom rung
first push: he steps up, left foot on the second rung
halfway up, one rung at a time, hand then foot
a push brings his head level with the top of the ladder
the last push brings him to the top of the ladder, feet on the top-but-one rung, hands on the tops of the rails
he stays bent forward over the top of the ladder against the haystack, head inside the frame
